pairs_touching.what_says_this: A is explicitly Step 25C.3 (S0895) and B is explicitly Step 25C.2 (S0894) of the same sequential KnowledgeOS theory-step series. B establishes via numerical Bayesian likelihood-ratio experiments that duplicate/copied evidence must not manufacture false certainty (LR1*LR2 legitimate only under genuine independence; a perfect duplicate gives zero additional posterior shift) -- the 'don't count copied evidence twice' empirical rule. A directly builds on and formalizes this: 'Establishes that the earlier don't count copied evidence twice rule has a rigorous information-theoretic interpretation (IG=0 for derived copies), not merely a governance convention' -- explicitly citing B's finding and grounding it in Shannon entropy (IG(E;H)=Ent(H)-Ent(H|E)). A also reuses B's three information-gain cases (duplicate=0, dependent=less, independent=>0) as its starting classification.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If A's formal IG framework contradicted rather than grounded B's empirical duplicate-detection/independence rule (e.g. a different formal criterion for when evidence counts as independent), this would be REDEFINITION rather than CONTINUATION/formal-refinement. Not the case -- the three-case classification (duplicate/dependent/independent) carries over unchanged.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Both steps sit ~19 steps apart in the same numbered Lord/decision-theory sequence (Step 6 -> ... -> Step 25C.3); the evidence-dependence correction in A (avoiding double-counting derived/duplicate evidence) is the key delta over B and would be the natural anchor if this pair is promoted to a formal lineage claim later.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: Group evidence is STRING-SIMILARITY only (Jaccard=0.50), but content continuity is very strong: A (Step 25C.3) defines IG(E;H)=Ent(H)-Ent(H|E) and VOI(q)=E[max_a EU(a|K_t,E_q)]-max_a EU(a|K_t)-Cost(q); B (Step 6) defines the near-identical base forms IG(e;P)=H(P)-H(P|e) and utility/value-of-evidence U_rho(e)=Benefit-Cost, VOE_rho(e), q*=argmax_q U_rho(q). A explicitly adds a new dimension B lacks: evidence DEPENDENCE -- conditional information gain IG(E2;H|E1), NovelInformation(E|K), and the derived-copy/duplicate-evidence correction (IG≈0 for E2=f(E1)) -- building directly on B's entropy-based IG and VOI/EDR/VOE apparatus rather than introducing a competing formalism. No SOURCE-CLAIMED-* row formally names one family from the other (A's own continuation claim points forward to step-025d, B's points forward to step-007).
